item.title: End User: Filter bubbles erode democracy
item.description: Search engines and social networks seemingly provide resources that connect individuals through accessible information and debate. But invisibly, algorithmic editing of the web increasingly isolates users, trapping them in “filter bubbles” through hyper-personalized results. Online platforms should seek users’ permission to personalize online content and provide a clear and easy way to opt in or out.
